summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering. The company sold 8,000,000 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase 12,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $0.01 per share to an accredited investor. The offering was consummated on July 28, 2026, with net proceeds of approximately $3.63 million. Univest Securities acted as placement agent, receiving a 6.0% cash fee plus expenses. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
